paragraphs: Anani bar Sasson, Zevaḥim 88b. He expounded at the nasi's household's entrance, and R. Ammi objected, Mo'ed Katan 24b. In R. Yishmael son of R. Yose's name, Shabbat 64b; Naḥalat Shimoni erred in this.
